layouts.name: Pocono - 2.5 Mile Road Course
layouts.description: Draft configuration: Operator All Course 2020 document, North/South Option 1 named 2.51 Mile, identifies the complete western north-course S bends joined to the full northern, eastern and front oval sections. Southeast infield options, the upper oval shortcut and pit lane are excluded. Exact independent source nodes form this draft route. Mapped distance and catalogue scalar remain separate; fine alignment, travel direction and historical timing correspondence are provisional. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 4122.3 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
